notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Version 2.0 adds:
- 4 difficulty levels (original is called very hard)
- A new type of lock (press or hold lock button to stop moving).
All that can be changed in the options menu.
Also bug causing crashes between levels and a few small bugs were fixed.
